experience.context: Dhaka, Bangladesh (Hybrid) | Sports membership & club-management platform | .NET 9, SQL Server, Dapper
bullets: Owned backend delivery across Member Profile, Venue Management, Invoice Management, and Payment modules of a modular .NET platform, keeping API behavior consistent across modules for web and mobile clients.

Integrated Adyen payment methods — ACH, BACS Direct Debit, SEPA Direct Debit, and PayTo — with cart/store-based merchant account and API-key resolution, enabling payments across the UK, US, Europe, and Australia.
Reduced a high-traffic grid API from ~110s to 9–13s (~90% faster) through query-level tuning and caching.
Resolved provider, currency, acquirer, refund-tax, and asynchronous payment-status defects across payment workflows, improving reliability of failed and pending transactions.
Built audit logging and observability — profile-level change tracking, receipt-level logs, and provider-response analysis — speeding up troubleshooting and traceability.
Implemented business-critical validation and workflow logic with xUnit tests for core scenarios, improving accuracy and regression resistance.

experience.company: DataSoft Systems Bangladesh Ltd. — Client: bKash

bullets: Developed and maintained mission-critical .NET Core applications for bKash, sustaining 99.9% uptime in production for 50M+ users.
Led a 500 GB+ SQL Server → MySQL migration with a <2-hour cutover window (minimal downtime), including full rollback and validation planning.
Automated Excel/PDF reporting pipelines with ASP.NET Core and Jenkins CI/CD, cutting manual effort by 70% and deployment time from 4 hours to 30 minutes.
Owned escalated production incidents through systematic root-cause analysis, eliminating recurring performance degradation during peak business hours.
Designed RBAC for 500+ users, AES-256 encryption for sensitive data, and activity audit trails.
Mentored junior developers on SOLID, code review, and unit testing.
Delivered 5+ internal operational tools with ASP.NET Core and Blazor, improving business-process visibility across departments.
Optimized SQL queries and stored procedures, reducing report generation from 10 minutes to under 2 minutes (80%).
Built secure RESTful APIs with JWT authentication handling 10K+ daily requests at <200 ms average response time.
Diagnosed and resolved defects across UI, business logic, and database layers.
Delivered ASP.NET / C# backend and SQL Server projects for remote clients, covering API development, schema design, and bug-fix contracts.

projects.title: bKash Integrated Sales Management System (ISMS)
projects.problem: Nationwide sales platform needed to handle 3x peak transaction volume on existing infrastructure.
projects.approach: Index and query-plan optimization across high-traffic paths.
projects.result: Handles 3x peak volume on same infrastructure. Replaced 40-hour monthly manual reconciliation with a 2-hour automated compliance report (~450 person-hours saved/year).

projects.title: JustGo — Sports Membership & Club Management Platform
projects.problem: Enterprise needed a modular platform serving web + mobile clients across multiple domains and regions.
projects.approach: Modular REST API covering membership, organization, booking, venue, invoice, class, and results domains. Multi-region Adyen payment integration with cart/store-based merchant account resolution.
projects.result: Enterprise-scale platform serving web and mobile clients with multi-region payment support across UK, US, Europe, and Australia.

projects.title: EduNest — Multi-Tenant School Management System
projects.problem: Schools need a multi-tenant management platform with strict data isolation and reliable payment reconciliation.
projects.approach: Built a modular monolith with Clean Architecture (Domain, Application, Infrastructure, API layers). Multi-tenant data isolation on shared infrastructure, Redis distributed caching, RabbitMQ async processing, and a payment CSV export with cent-level reconciliation logic.
projects.result: Multi-tenant school management platform with tenant-level isolation, RBAC (super admin/admin/school-level) with JWT authentication, Redis + RabbitMQ for high-volume operations, and cent-level payment accuracy. Private codebase; architecture walkthrough available on request.

Backend: ASP.NET Core (Web API, MVC, Razor Pages)
